business.name: Breakout Escape Rooms
business.description: Breakout Escape Rooms offers immersive, themed escape room adventures for friends, families, corporate teams, and party groups. With locations in Mumbai and Bangalore, we provide world-class puzzles, professional game masters, and unforgettable experiences.

mumbai.address: Breakout Escape Rooms, 3rd Floor, Phoenix Marketcity, LBS Marg, Kurla West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400070

operating_hours.holidays: Open on all public holidays. Closed only on Holi and Diwali.

parking.availability: Mall parking available at Phoenix Marketcity.
parking.valet: Valet parking available at the mall entrance.

escape_rooms.name: Prison Break
escape_rooms.theme: You are wrongfully imprisoned in a high-security jail. Find clues, solve puzzles, and escape before the warden returns in 60 minutes.
escape_rooms.age_recommendation: 12+ (under 14 must be accompanied by an adult)

escape_rooms.name: Haunted Mansion
escape_rooms.theme: You enter an abandoned mansion rumored to be haunted. Unravel the mystery of the ghost before time runs out. Not for the faint-hearted!
escape_rooms.age_recommendation: 16+ (contains horror elements, jump scares, and dark environments)
escape_rooms.accessibility: Not wheelchair accessible due to narrow corridors
escape_rooms.warning: Contains horror elements including jump scares, darkness, fog, and live actors. Not recommended for individuals with heart conditions, epilepsy, or severe anxiety.

notes: GST (18%) is included in the listed price.
Public holidays are charged at weekend rates.

bangalore.address: Breakout Escape Rooms, 2nd Floor, Orion Mall, Dr. Rajkumar Road, Rajajinagar, Bangalore, Karnataka 560010
bangalore.landmark: Inside Orion Mall, 2nd Floor near PVR Cinemas

operating_hours.holidays: Open on all public holidays. Closed only on Ugadi and Diwali.

parking.availability: Mall parking available at Orion Mall.
parking.valet: Valet parking available at the main entrance.

escape_rooms.name: The Heist
escape_rooms.theme: You are a team of elite thieves breaking into a high-security museum vault. Crack the codes, bypass the lasers, and steal the diamond before the alarm goes off!
escape_rooms.age_recommendation: 12+ (under 14 must be accompanied by an adult)

escape_rooms.name: Zombie Apocalypse
escape_rooms.theme: A zombie virus has broken out in the city. You are trapped in a research lab with the antidote hidden somewhere. Find it and escape before the zombies break through!

booking.advance_payment: 50% advance payment required to confirm booking. Remaining 50% payable at the venue.
booking.confirmation: Booking confirmation with ID, date, time, room, and receipt sent via WhatsApp and email within 15 minutes.
booking.arrival: Please arrive 15 minutes before your slot for briefing and safety instructions.

rescheduling.free_window: Free rescheduling up to 24 hours before the booking.
rescheduling.late_reschedule: Within 24 hours: subject to availability, may incur ₹200 fee.

cancellation_policy.free_cancellation: Up to 24 hours before booking — full refund within 5-7 business days.
cancellation_policy.late_cancellation: Less than 24 hours — no refund, but can reschedule once.
cancellation_policy.refund_method: Refunds processed to original payment method within 5-7 business days.
cancellation_policy.refund_disputes: Must be escalated to a human support agent.

age_policy.under_14: Players under 14 must be accompanied by a participating adult (18+).
age_policy.horror_rooms: Horror-themed rooms (Haunted Mansion, Zombie Apocalypse) recommended for 16+/14+ respectively.
age_policy.id_requirement: Age verification may be requested. Please carry valid ID.

food_and_beverage.water: Water bottles allowed but must be kept in designated area outside game room.
food_and_beverage.dining: Mall food courts available at both locations.

rules: Emergency exit buttons in every room.
Live game master monitors every session.
No physical force required — do not break or damage props.
Players under influence of alcohol/drugs will not be permitted.
Press emergency button or call out if you feel unwell.
safety.health_advisory: Players with heart conditions, epilepsy, claustrophobia, or severe anxiety should consult staff before booking horror-themed rooms.
safety.injury_protocol: Staff trained in basic first aid. Serious incidents escalated immediately. All injuries must be reported to human support.

personal_belongings.policy: All belongings (phones, bags, wallets) must be stored in free lockers before entering.
personal_belongings.liability: Breakout is not responsible for loss or damage of personal belongings.

common_policies.dress_code: Comfortable clothing and closed-toe shoes recommended. No high heels or open-toe sandals.

photography.after_game: Group photos with Breakout props encouraged in the designated photo area.

discounts_and_offers.note: All discounts apply equally to both Mumbai and Bangalore locations unless stated otherwise.
general_rules: Only ONE discount or offer can be applied per booking.
Discounts cannot be combined or stacked.
Discounts applied on base price before taxes.
Management reserves the right to modify or withdraw offers without notice.
Custom discount negotiations must be escalated to a human agent.

group_discounts.description: Discounts for larger groups booking together.
conditions: All players must book under a single booking.

includes: Complimentary birthday decoration in briefing area
conditions: Book at least 48 hours in advance.
Birthday person plays FREE if 6+ paying players.
Government ID or proof of birthday may be required.
birthday_party_package.how_to_book: Call or WhatsApp the respective location and mention 'Birthday Package'.

conditions: Book at least 5 business days in advance.
Corporate bookings above 20 people require escalation to events team.
corporate_packages.how_to_book: Email corporate@breakout.in or WhatsApp the location.

conditions: First slot of the day only.
Previous booking reference or registered phone number required.

festive_offers.how_to_check: Follow @breakoutescaperooms on Instagram or visit breakout.in for current offers.

conditions: Customer reports injury or safety issue
Customer expresses frustration, anger, or dissatisfaction
Customer explicitly asks for a human agent
Special accessibility requests not in SOP
escalation.message: I understand your concern. Let me connect you with a human support agent who can assist you further. Our team will get back to you within 30 minutes during operating hours.

lead_qualification.purpose: Collect customer details to personalize experience and assist sales.

questions.question: Which location are you interested in — Mumbai or Bangalore?
Is this booking for friends, family, a birthday party, or a corporate event?
How many players are you expecting?
Which difficulty level interests you — Medium or Hard?
What date and time are you planning to visit?
Have you played escape rooms before?

agent.name: Closira
agent.persona: Closira is the friendly and knowledgeable AI customer support assistant for Breakout Escape Rooms. Warm, professional, concise, and always prioritizes accuracy over assumptions.
agent.greeting: Hey there! 👋 I'm Closira, your virtual assistant at Breakout Escape Rooms. We have locations in Mumbai and Bangalore! How can I help you today?
agent.farewell: Thanks for chatting with me! If you need anything else, feel free to reach out anytime. Have a great day! 🎉
